govdocs-archive_org-nsia-AlbaAdrian_Adri: This item — Adrian Alba — creator unknown — is a National Security Internet Archive file. The file’s full context is unclear. Its subject seems to be the JFK case. Archivists value such fragments. The item is a fragment of the archive.
the-lives-of-the-twelve-caesars-volume-0: Old, stern, and honest, the general Galba became emperor at seventy-three when Nero fell — and lasted seven months. Suetonius shows a man whose very virtues made him unfit for the job: his strictness alienated the soldiers, who murdered him in the Forum. The first casualty of Rome's Year of the Four Emperors, and a lesson in the limits of virtue.
a-lady-s-life-on-a-farm-in-manitoba: Mary Georgina Caroline Hall describes her years keeping house on a Manitoba farm — the isolation, the work, the prairie winters, and the small triumphs of pioneer womanhood. Written with honesty and spirit, her memoir is a valuable woman's view of settling the Canadian West.
a-trip-to-manitoba: Mary Agnes FitzGibbon, a young Englishwoman, describes her trip to Manitoba — the prairie land, the settlers, the new life rising on the frontier. Her fresh, lively letters capture the West in the making. A charming woman's view of pioneer Canada.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-abba: This 1913 Catholic Encyclopedia article on Abba — the Aramaic word for father, used by Christ in prayer — traces its scriptural and liturgical use. Anthony Maas unfolds its tender significance. A brief, illuminating reference entry. Christ's own prayer word, cherished by Christians ever since.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-ales-and-terr: A 1913 entry on Ales and Terralba — the Sardinian diocese of the highlands. Ernesto Buonaiuti gives its history. Its bishops served a rugged flock. The island's faith runs deep. A mountain see of old Sardinia. Its cathedral keeps a Spanish retablo.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-alvaro-alonzo: A 1913 entry on Alvaro Alonso Barba — the metallurgist of Potosí. Adolph Bandelier notes his silver science. His Arte de los metales taught the miners. The New World's wealth flowed through his art. A priest of the furnace. His furnace methods enriched the crown.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-antonio-de-tr: This 1913 reference piece on Antonio de Trueba — Antón the singer of Basque songs. Jeremiah Ford praises his tales. His Cantares charmed all Spain. The people's poet of the north. The bard of the Basque hills. His Cuentos delight the Spanish reader.
